title: Interact Sports excellence Award
description:
🏆 Celebrating Sporting Excellence!

Vriddhi Shah Shines at Interact District Conference – UDAAN

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Interact Club of Amulakh Amichand International School

🌟 A Proud Moment for Our Young Achiever! 🌟

The Interact Club of Amulakh Amichand International School, supported by the Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, proudly celebrates the achievement of Vriddhi Shah, a student of Standard VIII, who received the Sports Excellence Award of the Year at the Interact District Conference UDAAN.

This prestigious recognition celebrates Vriddhi’s sporting excellence and highlights the importance of dedication, discipline, perseverance and a passion for achievement. Her accomplishment is an inspiration to fellow students, encouraging young people to pursue their interests, discover their potential and strive for excellence.

The award also reflects the importance of nurturing young talent and providing students with opportunities to showcase their abilities beyond the classroom.

👏 Congratulations, Vriddhi! Your achievement makes your school, Interact Club and Rotary Club proud. May this be the beginning of many more milestones and victories!

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown remains committed to empowering young leaders, encouraging talent and celebrating the achievements of the next generation.

🌟 Young Talent. Sporting Spirit. Outstanding Achievement!

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Empowering Youth • Inspiring Excellence • Creating Lasting Impact
